name: switch
summary: Binary on/off toggle for committing a setting immediately when the control changes. Mirrors the canonical [Web-ODS Shared Library → Switch master](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=717-48394&m=dev) (`717:48394`) and its text-label compositions (`732:49743`, `732:49642`, `732:49755`, `732:49666`). Every visual binds to other brand `THEME = other brand` + `PLATFORM = other brand / Desktop|Tablet|Mobile` Variable resolutions — the multi-brand master is consumed under the other brand mode pick per the contract in [`storybook-other brand-figma-modes.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: Drives the ON-state track paint. Mirrors the Figma `Tone` property.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Persistent state. Sets the native `<input>` `checked` attribute and `aria-checked="true"` on the input; the knob slides right via the `is-checked` class on the root.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Persistent state. Paints the `--color-disabled-*` token trio, adds `aria-disabled="true"` on the root, and sets the native `disabled` attribute on the input (removes it from the tab order).

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Persistent state. Replaces the knob's icon slot with a spinner and locks the input via `aria-busy="true"` on the root. Click commits are ignored while loading.

properties.name: showIcon
properties.description: Renders the checkmark glyph inside the knob when checked. When `false`, the knob paints as a solid circle.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional visible label rendered after the track (BEM element `c-switch__label`). When omitted, the switch is icon-only — consumers MUST supply an `aria-label` via the `accessibleLabel` prop.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Bound to the native input's `aria-label`. Required when no visible label is present so the switch's purpose is announced.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Bound to the native `<input>` `name` attribute for form submission.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Bound to the native `<input>` `value` attribute (the value posted when checked).

variants.values: `default` (track paints `--color-signal-info` on ON) / `success` (track paints `--color-signal-success`) / `critical` (track paints `--color-signal-critical`). Tone only affects the ON paint; the OFF track is the neutral border-subtle fill in every tone.

`default` / `hover` / `focused` / `pressed`. Pseudo-class driven (`:hover` / `:focus-visible` / `:active` on the native input). The `[data-state]` hook on the root lets the AllStyles gallery freeze each paint for visual regression.

accessibility: Uses native `<input type="checkbox">` with `role="switch"` + `aria-checked` for the binary state — screen readers announce "On" / "Off" directly.
Always carries either a visible `<label>` (text after the track) or an `aria-label` via `accessibleLabel`. The label is wrapped in the root `<label>` element so clicking the text toggles the switch.
Focus ring uses `:focus-visible` so it only appears on keyboard navigation; pointer focus stays quiet.
WCAG: track surfaces meet AA non-text contrast against `--color-bg-default` in every tone × state combination. Disabled paint meets WCAG 2.2 § 1.4.11 by retaining a visible outline.
Reduced motion: the knob's slide transition is removed when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set.
